column1: # Parts of the game the world map draws elsewhere,
# from the game cache's composite maps; built by local-development/tools/map-icons (WorldMapMoves).
# map id <tab> x y width height (where it is drawn) <tab> dx dy floor floors: add dx dy to get where it is;
# its floor is the drawn floor above the lowest one moved (floor), at most floors - 1 above it.
# With dx dy 0 0 and floor 0 the part is drawn where it is, its floors above (floors of them) drawn flat on it.
